bagPolicy.summary: Only one small bag per person is allowed, not exceeding A4 size dimensions. Large bags, including rucksacks, are prohibited.
allowed: Small bags not bigger than A4 size (29.7cm x 21cm x 15cm)
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is street parking available locally which can be reserved ahead of arrival using JustPark. The Mailbox car park is nearby, about 600 metres away, with standard tariffs and 16 accessible spaces.

rideshare.note: The venue points fans to Bolt for rides to and from the concert. Download the Bolt app to book a ride.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at O2 Academy Birmingham varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If you're coming to a show in the main auditorium or O2 Academy2 Birmingham, there's an accessible toilet on the balcony level (first floor), it’s controlled by a RADAR key and our staff will also provide access to it if needed and also in stalls.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted. Once you leave the venue, you cannot come back in.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The venue has a box office, but its opening hours vary, so check the Contact us page before you go. If tickets are still available, you can buy them on the day through Ticketmaster or in person at the venue. Club nights can be different.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Your ticket shows the door time, and the event page lists both the door time and curfew. When possible, there is a separate queue for O2 Priority members, who can bring up to three friends; look for the Priority queue signs at the entrance.
